decisions.reason: The source concerns outbound HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list transfer, not Apollo-to-HubSpot contact ingestion.
Generic HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list transfer does not necessarily resume or change the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow, which also governs lead selection and follow-up campaign handling.
The requested connections require no stated change to MeetAlfred's existing configuration requirement or Pro subscription plan.
Connecting an email account to MeetAlfred and HubSpot does not necessarily resume or modify the deferred automated email campaign.
The source changes email connectivity and HubSpot list transfer, not LinkedIn campaign automation.
Pushing existing HubSpot lists to MeetAlfred does not change the defined HubSpot lead-management properties, categorization, list creation, notes, or task assignment behavior.
The source does not mention Zapier or alter its active configuration, plan, or add-on requirements.
Adding email connections and list transfer does not revoke or modify the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
Connecting an email account to the platforms does not necessarily establish or change synchronization of lead email and LinkedIn chat histories into HubSpot.
The email-integration clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the separate list-transfer clause belongs to the source Requirement.
HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list transfer does not alter the deferred and unresolved direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration.
The source does not change how CRM duplicate status is displayed while viewing LinkedIn profiles.
